Term Detail

High margin item

GENERAL • High-margin feature
Back
Tech Equivalents
Restaurant Definition
In a professional kitchen, 'High margin item' represents a specific operational concept tied to product & monetization. It reflects how teams coordinate work, manage resources, and maintain flow under real-time pressure. In technology environments, this maps to 'High-margin feature', highlighting similar principles of system reliability, workflow coordination, and performance optimization. Understanding this concept helps teams design processes that are resilient, efficient, and scalable.
  • Kitchen: The team ensures 'High margin item' is completed before service begins.
  • Tech Ops: Engineers confirm high-margin feature is complete before deployment.
  • Failure Scenario: When 'High margin item' is skipped, delays and errors cascade.
  • Scaling Scenario: Strong high-margin feature practices allow systems to scale smoothly.
Tech Definition
High-margin feature
  • Think of 'High margin item' like high-margin feature in a distributed system — if it isn’t done correctly
  • downstream services fail
  • latency increases
  • and recovery becomes expensive.
